market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile. Oil above $100 and trade war escalation create headline risk. Oracle earnings and PPI data are binary catalysts. Bessent's failed yield intervention suggests policy uncertainty. Expect 5-8% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks. Gold and energy outperform; growth and duration underperform.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if Iran de-escalates and trade wars stabilize. AI capex cycle remains intact but faces scrutiny (Oracle, Microsoft yield test). Energy transition (nuclear, antimony, Angola oil) offers structural growth. India and emerging markets benefit from China rotation. Higher rates cap multiple expansion but favor value and dividend growers.
